runs.description: Run ids. The wait ends when any of them finishes.

workers.description: Worker ids. The wait ends when the worker's current run finishes.

timeout_secs.description:
How long to wait, in seconds. Default 30 unless the server's configuration file sets another, capped by the server's wait
ceiling. A timeout is not an error.

after.description:
The `cursor` of an earlier `wait` or `read`. With it, the call returns
at once when something named finished after that cursor.

outputSchema.title: WaitResponse
outputSchema.description:
The answer to `wait`. A timeout is not an error: `timed_out` is true and
the states are current. A wait that shutdown released says
`released_by_shutdown`.

cursor.description:
Pass this as `after_cursor` on the next call to see only what finishes
after this response.

timed_out.description: True when the time passed and nothing named had finished.

released_by_shutdown.description:
True when shutdown released the wait. Nothing named need have finished:
a run can still be `running` while it is stopped, so `timed_out: false`
does not mean something finished. Absent otherwise.

limit_reached.description:
Set when the wait would have blocked and as many waits as
`max_waits_in_flight` allows were blocked already. The wait did not
block: `timeout_secs` is 0 and the states are current, as for a wait
asked with `timeout_secs: 0`. Absent otherwise.

timeout_secs.description:
The wait that applied, in seconds, after the ceiling. 0 when
`limit_reached` is set.

runs.description: The runs named, in the order given, minus the unknown ones.

workers.description: The workers named, in the order given, minus the unknown ones.

unknown.description: Ids that name nothing: wrong, or their results have gone.

WaitLimit.description: The limit that kept a `wait` from blocking.

oneOf.description: As many waits as `max_waits_in_flight` allows were blocked already.

worker.description: Its worker, if it has one.

changed.description: With `after_cursor`: whether it finished after that cursor.

oneOf.description: Waiting behind another run on its worker, or for a running slot.

Outcome.description: How a run ended. Every run ends in exactly one of these.

oneOf.description: The provider finished the assignment and returned a final answer.
The provider or delega hit an error; `error.kind` says which.
The caller stopped the run, or went away.

The run did not go ahead: invalid request, a limit, or a denied
permission that stopped it.

WorkerBrief.description: One worker in a `wait` or `list` response.

current_run.description: Its running run, or the next queued one when nothing is running.

queue_length.description: How many runs wait behind the running one.

changed.description: With `after_cursor`: whether a run of this worker finished after it.

WorkerState.description: Where a worker is. Derived from its runs: see the module documentation.

oneOf.description: No run is running and at least one waits for a running slot.
A run is running. More may be queued behind it.
Nothing is running or queued. A follow-up can be given.
Closed. Final. Its results stay readable for the retention time.
